name: SHAKESPEARE? More like THIRSTspeare, amirite?
source:
You know the drill. It's a dating sim. But wait: not just any dating sim! One (or more) of your crushes like dating sims, and you, a humble programmer, have decided that is what you will make IN ORDER TO WIN THEIR HEART.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627740/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你知道该怎么做。这是一款约会模拟游戏。但等等：这不仅仅是约会模拟游戏！你迷恋的一个（或多个）人，比如约会模拟游戏，而你，一个谦虚的程序员，已经决定做这件事来赢得他们的心。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1627740/]Steam[/url]]
